_comment: District and municipal emergency contacts for the Budhi Gandaki valley. NOTHING HERE IS AUTO-POPULATED, and nothing here may be guessed. Every entry must be copied from an official source — the District Administration Office Gorkha, the District Emergency Operation Centre, or the Nepal Police district listing — with the source and the date it was checked. Ship this empty rather than approximate: the page hides any district with no verified numbers and shows the national helplines instead.
